text: When Doc:* and Component:* artifacts are registered but Extract Log artifact is not, the registrations were cleared by a force-push — the functional analyzer can read raw .aee/extract-log.jsonl and .aee/kb/ directly rather than returning [PASS].

When a functional-analyzer batch contains only entry-point wrapper files with 0 function/method/class symbols, the aee-cluster step can be safely skipped — there are no members to partition, and the functions/ output files are written with empty arrays.
